title: Training-coverage expert routing over the confidence-gated slate consensus
hypothesis: Because the official metric ranks all seven validation days jointly within each user, full-slate repetition statistics can recover policy-confidence and fatigue signals that causal session features miss. Frozen experts have complementary errors for users with weak training outcomes and for users whose evaluation candidates overlap their training exposure, so training-only coverage gates can route those regimes without reading validation outcomes.

protocol.ranking_unit: all logged validation impressions for one user
candidate_information_used: static tag tokens and item statistics
protocol.selection: Tune each scalar only on disjoint user folds. The first eight stages use two user-parity folds; the remaining conditional, temporal, training-prior, confidence-gated, structural-routing, and coverage-routing stages use four user-id-modulo folds. Train the batch-slate tree on April 14-19, early-stop on April 20-21, refit on April 14-21, then select only its outer consensus scalar on the same four disjoint user folds. Gate final corrections using label-free normalized top margin and slate structure, plus training-only smoothed user outcomes and identifier coverage. Fix every deployable weight to the mean of independently selected weights.
protocol.coverage_threshold_protocol: Compute the low-rate threshold as the row-weighted first quartile of Bayesian-smoothed April 8-21 user long-view rates. Mark prior-video coverage when a validation user-video identifier pair occurred in April 8-21; validation labels are never accessed.

features.token_personal_mean: Within-user standardized mean across an item's tag tokens of log1p(user-slate token count) - 0.25 * log1p(global-slate token count).
features.repeated_video: Within-user standardized indicator that the exact video occurs more than once in the supplied evaluation slate.
features.author_frequency: Within-user standardized log1p count of the author in the supplied evaluation slate.
features.music_unique_videos: Within-user standardized number of distinct videos using the same music.
features.author_repeat_per_video: Within-user standardized log1p ratio of author exposures to distinct videos for that author.
features.token_videos_per_author_mean: Within-user standardized mean across tag tokens of log1p(distinct token videos / distinct token authors).
features.type_leave_one_out_score: Within-user standardized mean accepted score of the other slate rows with the same video type; singleton groups retain their own score.
features.author_leave_one_out_score: Within-user standardized mean accepted score of the other slate rows with the same author; singleton groups retain their own score.
features.author_daypart_leave_one_out_delta: Within-user standardized difference between the accepted score and the other rows sharing author and four-hour daypart, computed after the broad type/author graph pass.
features.music_type_leave_one_out_delta: Within-user standardized difference between the accepted score and the other rows sharing music and video type, recomputed after the author-daypart correction.
features.log_session_length: Within-user standardized log1p length of the 30-minute-gap session reconstructed from time_ms.
features.date_tab_leave_one_out_score: Within-user standardized mean accepted score of other rows on the same date and tab, recomputed after session length and tab corrections.
features.immediate_temporal_neighbor_delta: Within-user standardized difference between each row's accepted score and the mean score of its immediately previous/next chronological neighbors.
features.recent3_user_threshold_duration_long_rat: Within-user standardized, Bayesian-smoothed user × {under 10s, 10-18s, at least 18s} long-view rate from training dates April 19-21 only.
features.recent7_tab_long_rate: Within-user standardized, Bayesian-smoothed tab long-view rate from training dates April 15-21 only.
features.all_user_author_completion_rate: Within-user standardized, Bayesian-smoothed user × author 95%-completion rate from the complete April 8-21 training block.
features.joint_log_user_video_count: Within-user standardized log count of the exact user-video pair in the supplied batch slate; it refines the earlier binary repeat flag.
features.batch_slate_tree: Temporally trained CatBoost correction using static metadata, full-slate totals, session lengths, base-score leave-one-out groups, and neighboring base predictions. It never receives validation outcomes.
features.joint_ordinal_consensus: Within-user ordinal rank of the champion after the continuous repeat penalty and tiny batch-slate tree correction, added back at a cross-fitted scalar weight.
features.high_margin_ordered_consensus: For rows belonging to the row-weighted highest quartile of within-user normalized top-score margin, add 0.34 times the rank difference between the frozen temporally ordered CatBoost and the preceding champion. The gate and correction use scores only.
features.median_margin_model_mean_consensus: For rows at or above the row-weighted median normalized top-score margin, add 0.01 times the difference between the mean within-user fractional rank of 20 frozen model families and the preceding champion rank.
features.two_active_days_ordered_extrapolation: For users appearing on exactly two supplied validation dates, extrapolate 0.5225 away from the frozen temporally ordered CatBoost rank.
features.three_four_active_days_watch_extrapolati: For users appearing on three or four supplied validation dates, extrapolate 0.175 away from the frozen watch-ratio DeepFM rank.
features.medium_slate_batch_consensus: For users with 6-10 supplied impressions, move 0.01 toward the frozen temporal batch-slate CatBoost rank.
features.low_training_rate_watch_consensus: For rows whose user is in the row-weighted lowest quartile of Bayesian-smoothed April 8-21 long-view rate, move 0.135 toward the frozen watch-ratio DeepFM rank.
features.prior_video_batch_extrapolation: For validation users having at least one exact user-video pair seen in April 8-21 training, extrapolate 0.03 away from the frozen temporal batch-slate CatBoost rank. The gate checks identifiers only.

rejected_followup.reason: The third-history-quartile mean residual reduced aggregate nDCG@5 and regressed two folds. The fourth-quartile median and recent-high-coverage watch residuals improved both aggregate metrics but each had a held-out fold loss too large relative to its tiny aggregate gain, so both were excluded.

acceptance: Accept only stages whose disjoint-user weights agree in sign, whose stitched cross-fitted primary improves over the preceding stage, and whose fixed recipe does not reduce either aggregate metric. The low-rate gate improved all four held-out folds. The prior-video gate improved three folds and changed the fourth by only -0.00000244, while improving both aggregate metrics; more fragile follow-ups were rejected.
